correctness.rationale: Fixing a chord of cyclic short interior length j leaves a uniform matching of 2n-2 residual endpoints, whose crossing mean is (n-1)(n-2)/6; conditional crossings with the fixed chord contribute j(2n-2-j)/(2n-3). Subtract n(n-1)/6, multiply by fixed-chord probability 1/(2n-1) and h_{n,j}=2n for j<n-1, n for j=n-1. Difference sign is t(t+1)-3(t-j)^2 for t=n-1. Zero forces (2t+1)^2-12(t-j)^2=1; positive Pell roots yield the listed (4,1),(49,20),... with all admissibility conditions. Sum of all L_{n,j}=n deterministically, forcing conservation. Independently enumerated all (2n-1)!! matchings and every exact covariance for n=2..6, including antipodal chords; finite checks do not replace the all-n conditional proof.
